question: Which place is said to bring about accomplishment of a Śākta mantra?
premises: The bank of the Sarasvatī is named.
Accomplishment of a Śākta mantra is attributed to it.
inference: The bank of the Sarasvatī brings about accomplishment of a Śākta mantra.
plain_english: Likewise, the bank of the Sarasvatī brings about accomplishment of a Śākta mantra.
